_comment: L1 runbook for support triage — the known errors and what to do about them. Shipped in the chart and mounted when supportRunbook.enabled (values.yaml). This copy is a generic EXAMPLE: a deployment keeps its team's own entries here. match: text (or a list of texts that must ALL appear) in the error, case-insensitive. action: wait | retrigger | check | escalate. Optional: category (upstream/process/unit/single/spread), when ({role: value}), escalate_to. First match wins.

entries.title: Upstream file not delivered
steps: Confirm with the upstream feed whether today's file was sent.
Do not re-run until the file has landed.
Once it lands, re-trigger the failed runs.

entries.title: Cloud quota exceeded
steps: Re-trigger once after 15 minutes — quota is usually per minute.
Fails again: escalate with the job ids.

entries.title: Access denied
steps: Do not re-run: a permission error repeats until access is fixed.
Escalate with the job ids and the error.

entries.title: Schema mismatch after a change
steps: Check the release history for a recent deploy of this process.
Escalate to the owning team; re-running will not help.
